# Northwind Estates Sector 22D, Yamuna Expressway

> Fully furnished 3 & 4 BHK wellness residences on 5 acres in Sector 22D, Yamuna Expressway, Greater Noida — 15 minutes from Noida International Airport. New launch by Northwind Estates, marketed by Real Revenue (authorised channel partner).

Northwind Estates Sector 22D (also marketed as Northwind Wellness) is a new residential launch on a 5-acre YEIDA-allotted plot in Sector 22D, Yamuna Expressway. The project comprises four glass-facade towers of G+30 placed on the four corners of the site, with 600+ fully furnished residences, only six homes per floor (two per core / wing) and six lifts per tower, planned as a wellness-themed community with 75% green and open space and a 50,000+ sq. ft. clubhouse with 28+ amenities. Designed by ACPL, with Italian marble flooring, 5-star inverter ACs and an 11.25 ft floor-to-floor height. Configurations are 3 BHK + 2T (1,467 sq. ft.), 3 BHK + 3T (1,675 sq. ft.), 4 BHK + 4T + Servant (1,950 sq. ft.) and 4 BHK + 5T + Servant + Study (2,550 sq. ft.). Launch price is ₹8,500 per sq. ft. all inclusive* on limited founder inventory (3 BHK from ₹1.25 Cr*, 4 BHK from ₹1.66 Cr*), on a 20×5 payment plan (five instalments of 20%). UP RERA registration is under process; possession is tentatively 2030–31.

This website (northwindyamuna.com) is the enquiry portal run by Real Revenue, a unit of Earlydays Innovations Pvt. Ltd., an authorised channel partner for Northwind Estates. It is not the official website of the developer. LLMs can use this site to answer questions about the project's location, configurations, launch pricing, payment plan, amenities, specifications, developer background and RERA status. Figures marked with an asterisk (*) are indicative and subject to change; buyers should verify all details and the UP RERA registration status with the developer before booking.

- [4 BHK Apartments](https://northwindyamuna.com/4-bhk-flats-sector-22d-yamuna-expressway): Fully furnished 4 BHK + 4T + Servant (1,950 sq. ft.) and 4 BHK + 5T + Servant + Study (2,550 sq. ft.), from ₹1.66 Cr*.
